backlog.spec: Replace Morgan bits with the full set of RDKit Descriptors (Descriptors.descList) computed per molecule. Replace nan/inf with 0 and clip to ±1e5. Train the same RandomForest (max_features 0.3).
backlog.title: RDKit 2D descriptors + RF

backlog.spec: Concatenate the RDKit 2D descriptors (cleaned of nan/inf) with Morgan count fingerprints (radius 2, 1024 bits, GetCountFingerprintAsNumPy). Fit the RF on the combined matrix.
backlog.title: Descriptors + count Morgan concatenated

backlog.spec: Use the RDKit 2D descriptors with LGBMRegressor (n_estimators 500, learning_rate 0.03, num_leaves 15, subsample 0.8, subsample_freq 1, colsample_bytree 0.5, min_child_samples 10, random_state seed, n_jobs 8, verbose -1).
backlog.title: LightGBM on descriptors

backlog.spec: Use the RDKit descriptors with CatBoostRegressor (iterations 800, depth 6, lr 0.05, loss MAE or RMSE, random_seed seed, thread_count 8, verbose 0).
backlog.title: CatBoost on descriptors

backlog.spec: Features are the RDKit descriptors plus Morgan counts at 1024 bits. Use XGBRegressor (n_estimators 600, max_depth 4, lr 0.03, subsample 0.8, colsample_bytree 0.4, reg_lambda 5, n_jobs 8).
backlog.title: XGBoost on descriptors+counts

backlog.spec: Use ExtraTreesRegressor (500 trees, max_features 0.5, min_samples_leaf 1) on the cleaned RDKit descriptors.
backlog.title: Extra trees on descriptors

backlog.spec: Use a hand-picked set of about 15 descriptors: MolLogP, TPSA, MolWt, NumHDonors, NumHAcceptors, NumRotatableBonds, FractionCSP3, RingCount, NumAromaticRings, HeavyAtomCount, LabuteASA, and so on. Fit a GradientBoostingRegressor or RF with min_samples_leaf 3.
backlog.title: Small physchem descriptor set

backlog.spec: Average the predictions of an RF, a LightGBM and a CatBoost model. All use descriptors plus Morgan counts, with seed-derived random states.
backlog.title: Ensemble RF + LGBM + CatBoost

backlog.spec: Because the loss is MAE, switch the GBM objective to L1 or Huber (LightGBM objective 'huber', alpha 0.5). Keep the descriptor features.
backlog.title: MAE objective

backlog.spec: Use RandomForestRegressor with criterion='absolute_error' (or return the median of the per-tree predictions) with 300 trees, on descriptors.
backlog.title: Median-based RF leaf

backlog.spec: Append the 167 MACCS keys (rdkit.Chem.MACCSkeys.GenMACCSKeys) to the descriptors. Fit RF or LightGBM.
backlog.title: MACCS keys added

backlog.spec: Concatenate hashed atom-pair counts (1024 bits) and topological-torsion counts (1024 bits) with the descriptors. Fit RF.
backlog.title: Atom-pair and torsion count FPs

backlog.spec: After computing the descriptors and fingerprints, drop features that are near-constant (variance below 1e-3 or present in fewer than 1% of molecules) on the training set only. Then fit the model.
backlog.title: Feature-selection by variance

backlog.spec: Standardize the descriptors (after clipping) with a QuantileTransformer or StandardScaler. Fit SVR(C=3, epsilon=0.1, gamma='scale').
backlog.title: SVR with RBF on standardized descriptors

backlog.spec: Compute a Tanimoto kernel on Morgan count fingerprints (radius 2, 2048 bits, min-max kernel). Fit SVR(kernel='precomputed', C=5) or KernelRidge.
backlog.title: Tanimoto-kernel SVR/KRR

backlog.spec: Blend 50/50 the RF on descriptors with the Tanimoto kernel ridge regression (alpha 0.5) predictions.
backlog.title: GP-like kernel ridge blend

backlog.spec: Use Morgan radius 3, with counts and 4096 bits. Use feature invariants (FCFP) as an additional block. Fit RF with max_features 0.2.
backlog.title: Feature-radius sweep

backlog.spec: With descriptors, set min_samples_leaf 2, max_features 0.2 and 600 trees. Alternatively, try max_features 'sqrt'.
backlog.title: RF hyperparameter retune

backlog.spec: Build out-of-fold predictions from RF, LGBM, SVR and CatBoost using an inner 5-fold split on the training set. Combine them with non-negative linear regression, then refit the base models on the full data.
backlog.title: Stacking with ridge meta-model

backlog.spec: Train the chosen model with 5 different seeds derived from seed, and average. This reduces variance for GBMs with subsampling.
backlog.title: Multi-seed bagging

backlog.spec: Add the EState fingerprint (rdkit.Chem.EState.Fingerprinter.FingerprintMol: counts and sums) and the fr_ fragment-count descriptors. Use RF.
backlog.title: Crippen/EState fragment features

backlog.spec: Before featurizing, keep the largest fragment (rdMolStandardize.LargestFragmentChooser). Neutralize charges using the Uncharger. Then use descriptors+RF.
backlog.title: Salt stripping and canonicalization

backlog.spec: Standardize the descriptors with QuantileTransformer(normal). Use sklearn MLPRegressor (hidden 256,64, alpha 1e-2, early_stopping, max_iter 500), averaged over 5 seeds.
backlog.title: MLP on scaled descriptors

backlog.spec: Clip the training targets to their 2nd–98th percentiles before fitting, to reduce the influence of outliers on the descriptor-based RF or GBM.
backlog.title: Target winsorizing

backlog.spec: Weight each training molecule by 1/sqrt(size of its Murcko scaffold group) so large congeneric series do not dominate. Pass them as sample_weight to the RF/LGBM.
backlog.title: Sample weights from scaffold duplicates

backlog.spec: Embed each molecule with ETKDG (seed fixed) and compute PMI, NPR1/2, PBF, asphericity, radius of gyration and the 3D PSA-like value. Append to the 2D descriptors. Fall back to 0 on failure.
backlog.title: 3D shape descriptors

backlog.spec: LightGBM with extra_trees=True, lambda_l2 10, num_leaves 8, 1000 trees at lr 0.02, feature_fraction 0.3 on the descriptors+MACCS features.
backlog.title: Dart/regularized LightGBM

backlog.spec: Fit one RF on Morgan counts, one on the descriptors, and one on MACCS+EState. Average the three predictions with equal weights.
backlog.title: Rank-average ensemble of diverse feature views

backlog.spec: Reduce the Morgan count fingerprints to 50 components with TruncatedSVD, fit on train+test SMILES features, which is unsupervised. Concatenate with the descriptors and fit LightGBM.
backlog.title: Descriptor-only with PCA-whitened fingerprint

backlog.spec: Add engineered features to the descriptors: TPSA/MolWt, MolLogP*TPSA, HBD/HAC, charge counts and the Lipinski violation count. Use RF or LGBM.
backlog.title: Polar-surface/logP-interaction features

backlog.spec: In fit_predict, change XGBRegressor to use objective='reg:pseudohubererror' (huber_slope=0.5) or 'reg:absoluteerror', keeping other hyperparameters. The metric is MAE and Caco-2 targets have outliers, so a robust loss may lower MAE. If absoluteerror is used, keep learning_rate 0.03 and n_estimators 600.
backlog.title: MAE-style objective in XGBoost

backlog.spec: Compute features once per call. Fit the existing XGBRegressor and a LGBMRegressor (n_estimators=800, learning_rate=0.03, num_leaves=15, subsample=0.8, subsample_freq=1, colsample_bytree=0.3, reg_lambda=5, min_child_samples=10, n_jobs=8, random_state=seed, verbose=-1) on the same descriptor+Morgan features. Return the mean of the two predictions.
backlog.title: LightGBM plus XGBoost average

backlog.spec: Featurize train and test once, then fit 5 XGBRegressors with the current hyperparameters but seeds seed*10+k for k in 0..4 (different subsample/colsample draws), and return the mean of their predictions. This reduces variance at about 5x cost, which is still well under budget.
backlog.title: Multi-seed XGBoost bagging

backlog.spec: Change XGBRegressor to n_estimators=1500, learning_rate=0.015, max_depth=3, min_child_weight=3, subsample=0.7, colsample_bytree=0.3, colsample_bynode=0.7, reg_lambda=10, reg_alpha=0.5, gamma=0.0. Small data with 1100+ features favors heavy regularization.
backlog.title: Slower, shallower XGBoost with stronger regularization

backlog.spec: Build the descriptor+Morgan feature matrix. Models: XGBoost (current), ExtraTreesRegressor(500 trees, max_features=0.3, min_samples_leaf=2, n_jobs=8), and SVR(RBF, C=3, epsilon=0.1) on StandardScaler plus QuantileTransformer(normal) transformed descriptors only. Average the three with weights 0.5, 0.25, 0.25. Diverse model families tend to cut MAE.
backlog.title: Stacked ensemble with ExtraTrees and SVR

backlog.spec: Inside fit_predict, fit a first XGBoost on train data, take the top 300 features by gain importance, then refit the final XGBoost on only those columns (same hyperparameters). Selection uses only training fold data. This removes noisy sparse Morgan bits.
backlog.title: Descriptor feature selection by importance

backlog.spec: Using sklearn, drop constant columns from descriptors, apply QuantileTransformer(output_distribution='normal', n_quantiles=200) fit on train, and train an ensemble of 5 MLPRegressor (hidden (256,64), alpha=1e-2, early_stopping=True, max_iter=500, different seeds). Blend 0.3 MLP + 0.7 XGBoost predictions.
backlog.title: MLP on quantile-scaled descriptors blended with XGBoost

backlog.spec: Extend featurize to also append the 167 MACCS keys (rdkit.Chem.MACCSkeys.GenMACCSKeys to numpy) and the per-atom-type EState sums from rdkit.Chem.EState.Fingerprinter.FingerprintMol (counts and sums). Keep the rest the same.
backlog.title: Add MACCS keys and Crippen/EState features

backlog.spec: Before featurizing, take the largest fragment of each molecule (rdMolStandardize.LargestFragmentChooser) and neutralize charges (rdMolStandardize.Uncharger). Fall back to the original mol on failure. This removes counterions that pollute the descriptors.
backlog.title: Chemistry-aware preprocessing: largest fragment, neutralize

backlog.spec: After fitting XGBoost, compute out-of-fold XGBoost residuals on the training set using 5-fold KFold, then for each test molecule add 0.5 times the Tanimoto-similarity-weighted mean residual of its 5 nearest training neighbors (Morgan bit fingerprints, only neighbors with similarity above 0.4). Add nothing if there are no such neighbors. The final model is the base XGBoost refit on all training data.
backlog.title: Pairwise-difference / kNN residual correction

backlog.spec: In featurize, append the 167-bit MACCS keys (rdkit.Chem.MACCSkeys.GenMACCSKeys converted to a numpy array) to the descriptors and Morgan counts. Also append the EState fingerprint sums from rdkit.Chem.EState.Fingerprinter.FingerprintMol (the counts part, 79 values). Keep XGBoost as is.
backlog.title: Add MACCS keys and Crippen/EState features

backlog.spec: Add an SVR (RBF, C=3, epsilon=0.1, gamma='scale') trained on descriptor columns only. Use QuantileTransformer(output_distribution='normal') followed by StandardScaler, fit on the training data. Return 0.7*XGBoost + 0.3*SVR predictions. This adds a smooth, diverse model that tree models lack.
backlog.title: Stacked blend with SVR on standardized descriptors

backlog.spec: Train an sklearn MLPRegressor (hidden layers (256,64), alpha=1e-2, early_stopping=True, max_iter=500) on the quantile-normal-scaled descriptors. Use 3 seeds averaged. Blend 0.75 XGBoost + 0.25 MLP. The MLP is a different inductive bias that may fix tree extrapolation errors on unseen scaffolds.
backlog.title: MLP on quantile-scaled descriptors blended with XGBoost

backlog.spec: In fit_predict, fit a first XGBoost on all features, keep the top 200 features by feature_importances_, refit the final XGBoost on only those columns, and predict. Use the same seed. This reduces noise from the 1024 sparse Morgan bits.
backlog.title: Feature selection by XGBoost importance

backlog.spec: After fitting XGBoost, get out-of-fold training predictions via 5-fold KFold cross_val_predict. Compute residuals. For each test molecule, find its 5 nearest training molecules by Tanimoto similarity on Morgan bits, and add 0.5 times the similarity-weighted mean of their residuals to the prediction. This corrects local systematic errors.
backlog.title: kNN residual correction

backlog.spec: In fit_predict, clip train_y to its 2nd and 98th percentiles before fitting XGBoost. Predict normally. This limits the influence of extreme outlier measurements on MAE.
backlog.title: Target winsorizing

backlog.spec: Replace the single XGBRegressor with an average of 5 XGBRegressors trained with seeds seed, seed+1, ..., seed+4 (same hyperparameters, subsample 0.8, colsample 0.4). Use the averaged prediction as p_xgb in the blend. This reduces variance from row and column subsampling. Check the job stays well under 10 minutes; featurize only once.
backlog.title: Multi-seed XGBoost bagging

backlog.spec: Change XGBRegressor to n_estimators=1500, learning_rate=0.01, max_depth=3, min_child_weight=3, subsample=0.7, colsample_bytree=0.3, colsample_bynode=0.7, reg_lambda=10, reg_alpha=0.5. Keep the blend unchanged. The aim is stronger regularization on a 580-molecule training set.
backlog.title: Slower shallower XGBoost

backlog.spec: At the start of fit_predict, clip y to its 2nd and 98th percentile (computed on train_y only) and train all three models on the clipped target. Predict as before. This limits the influence of extreme permeability values on tree and SVR fits under an MAE metric.
backlog.title: Target winsorizing before fitting

backlog.spec: In featurize, before computing descriptors and fingerprints, take the largest fragment of each molecule with rdMolStandardize.LargestFragmentChooser and neutralize it with rdMolStandardize.Uncharger. Fall back to the original molecule if anything fails. Everything else stays the same.
backlog.title: Salt stripping and neutralization preprocessing

backlog.spec: Tune the SVR member: use C=10, epsilon=0.05 and gamma='scale' on the quantile-normalized descriptors. As a variant inside the same slot, average two SVRs, one with C=3 and one with C=10, and raise the SVR blend weight to 0.3 while lowering XGB to 0.45 and ET to 0.25. Keep the rest as is.
backlog.title: SVR hyperparameter and kernel retune

backlog.spec: Add a KernelRidge (rbf kernel, alpha=0.3, gamma=1/(2*nd)) on the same StandardScaler+QuantileTransformer descriptors as the SVR. Blend as 0.4 XGB, 0.2 ET, 0.2 SVR, 0.2 KRR. This adds a smooth kernel model that is diverse from the trees.
backlog.title: Add Gaussian-process / kernel ridge member

backlog.spec: Wrap the whole three-model blend in a loop of 4 bootstrap resamples of the training set (sampling with replacement using np.random.RandomState(seed)). Train each model on each resample and average all predictions. Compute features once and index rows. Keep trees at lower counts (XGB 400, ET 300) so runtime stays below the limit.
backlog.title: Seeded bagging of the whole blend on bootstrap resamples

backlog.spec: In featurize, append MACCS keys (rdkit.Chem.MACCSkeys.GenMACCSKeys as a 167-vector) and the 79 EState_VSA/ VSA_EState-type sums via rdkit.Chem.EState.Fingerprinter.FingerprintMol counts (first array) to the descriptor and Morgan-count features. Make sure the SVR slice Xtr[:, :nd] still selects only RDKit descriptors, so place the new blocks after the Morgan counts.
backlog.title: Add MACCS keys and Crippen/EState counts

backlog.spec: After computing the blend, fit an ExtraTreesRegressor (200 trees, min_samples_leaf=5, max_features=0.3) on out-of-fold residuals of the blend computed with an inner 5-fold KFold on the training set, using only the RDKit descriptors. Add 0.5 times its predicted residual to the final prediction. For speed, reduce the inner XGB to 300 trees. This is a bolder change that tests whether systematic errors can be corrected.
backlog.title: Two-stage residual stacking with ET on blend residuals

backlog.spec: In featurize, before computing descriptors and fingerprints, parse each SMILES, keep only the largest fragment (rdkit.Chem.rdmolops.GetMolFrags with asMols=True, choose by heavy atom count), and neutralize charges with rdkit.Chem.MolStandardize.rdMolStandardize.Uncharger().uncharge(m). Fall back to the original molecule if anything fails. Keep everything else unchanged.
backlog.title: Salt stripping and neutralization

backlog.spec: In fit_predict, clip train_y to its 2nd and 98th percentiles (computed on the training fold only) before fitting all three models. Predictions are not clipped. Keep the blend unchanged.
backlog.title: Target winsorizing

backlog.spec: Change the XGBRegressor to objective='reg:pseudohubererror' with huber_slope=0.5 (base_score set to the median of y), keeping other hyperparameters. This tests a robust loss that is smoother than absoluteerror, which failed.
backlog.title: Huber-loss XGBoost

backlog.spec: Replace the SVR member with sklearn GaussianProcessRegressor using kernel ConstantKernel*RBF(length_scale=10) + WhiteKernel, normalize_y=True, on the quantile-normalized, StandardScaled descriptors (with constant columns dropped via variance filter). Keep the 0.25 weight and the remainder of the blend.
backlog.title: Kernel ridge / GP member on descriptors

backlog.spec: Append MACCS keys (rdkit.Chem.MACCSkeys.GenMACCSKeys, 167 bits) to the feature vector after the Morgan counts, used by XGB and ET only (the SVR still uses only the first nd columns). Keep everything else the same.
backlog.title: Chemistry-aware extra descriptors: MACCS plus Crippen contributions

backlog.spec: In fit_predict, wrap the existing blend in a loop of 4 iterations. Each iteration draws a bootstrap sample (rng seeded from seed+i, indices drawn with replacement) of the training rows and fits XGB, ET, and SVR on it with seed+i. Average the 4 blended predictions. Compute features once outside the loop.
backlog.title: Bootstrap bagging of the whole blend

backlog.spec: After the blend, compute out-of-fold blend predictions on the training set with a 5-fold KFold, using a lighter version (XGB 200 trees, ET 200 trees, SVR). Then fit a shallow ExtraTrees (max_depth 4, 200 trees, min_samples_leaf 10) on the OOF residuals using the descriptors, and add 0.5 times its prediction to the final blend. This is bold and may cost time, so keep the first stage light.
backlog.title: Residual-stacking second stage

backlog.spec: Set ExtraTrees to 1500 trees, max_features=0.15, min_samples_leaf=3, and raise its blend weight to 0.3 while reducing XGB to 0.45 and SVR to 0.25. This increases the regularization and diversity of the tree member.
backlog.title: Drop ET colsample and use a much bigger ET

backlog.spec: Change RADIUS to 3 and N_BITS to 2048 for the Morgan count fingerprint, with colsample_bytree for XGB lowered to 0.25 to compensate for the larger feature count. Keep everything else the same.
backlog.title: Rank-transformed descriptors for trees plus radius-3 Morgan

incumbent.description: Blend XGBoost (0.5) with ExtraTrees (0.25) and an RBF SVR on quantile-normalized descriptors (0.25).

memo: Helped: changing features and model together (slot 1, XGBoost on RDKit descriptors plus 1024-bit Morgan) cut loss from 0.4417 to 0.3741. Blending diverse models (slot 12: XGBoost 0.5, ExtraTrees 0.25, RBF SVR on quantile-normalized descriptors) reached 0.3659/0.3644, the incumbent at 0.3652 over 2 runs. Did not help: RF retuning (0.4539), Tanimoto SVR (0.4176), 16 hand-picked descriptors (0.4216), descriptors-only RF (0.3915), CatBoost (0.3765), dropping ExtraTrees (0.3739), RF-based blend (0.4033). Within noise (sd 0.0037): atom-pair/torsion fingerprints (0.3738), Morgan SVD (0.3771), MLP in blend (0.3649), kNN correction (0.3646), NNLS weights (0.3659), feature selection (0.3658). Feature additions and extra members look saturated near 0.365. Next: tune XGBoost (depth, learning rate, subsampling, colsample, regularization), try a target transform, and vary SVR C or kernel. Avoid new feature families and more blend members.
